item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: farazfrank777
item.content:encoded:
Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: Vintage Western Floral Embossed Leather Belt
item.dc:creator: farazfrank777
item.content:encoded: The Vintage Western Floral Embossed Leather Belt is a beautifully crafted accessory, combining traditional artistry with a touch of rugged elegance. Made from high-quality leather, the belt features intricate floral embossing along its length, adding a unique texture and depth to its rustic charm. The rich tan color complements any casual or semi-formal outfit, making it a versatile addition to any wardrobe. The standout feature is its antique-style buckle, adorned with ornate engravings, giving it a distinctly Western-inspired look. Designed for durability and comfort, this belt is lined with a smooth inner layer, providing a comfortable fit for all-day wear. The adjustable length ensures a customized fit, while the sturdy leather and reinforced buckle promise long-lasting use. Ideal for those who appreciate unique, handcrafted accessories, this belt adds character to jeans, trousers, or even dresses. It’s perfect for anyone looking to make a stylish statement with a Western twist.

item.content:encoded: The Western Floral Embossed Leather Belt combines classic craftsmanship with a unique, eye-catching design, perfect for adding flair to any outfit. Made from premium leather, the belt features intricate floral embossing along its length, bringing a touch of elegance and texture. The highlight of this belt is its silver-toned, floral-engraved buckle, which adds a bold, Western-inspired accent. The rich brown color makes it versatile, and suitable for both casual wear and semi-formal attire. Designed for durability and comfort, this belt offers a soft inner lining for all-day wear. The adjustable length provides a customized fit, while the robust leather and sturdy buckle ensure long-lasting use. Ideal for those who appreciate detailed designs, this belt is an excellent choice for anyone wanting to make a statement. Whether paired with jeans or tailored pants, this floral embossed belt elevates your style effortlessly.

item.content:encoded: The Personalized Monogram Leather Wallet offers a sophisticated design combined with a unique personal touch, making it the ideal accessory for modern men. Crafted from premium leather, the wallet showcases a sleek brown finish that complements any style. The embossed initials "NI" on the front add an exclusive and elegant detail, allowing for a customized appearance that sets it apart from standard wallets. Inside, the wallet features a well-organized layout with multiple card slots, a spacious cash compartment, and a secure coin pocket, ensuring easy access to your essentials. Its slim bi-fold design keeps it lightweight and compact, making it convenient for everyday carry without adding bulk. Built with durable stitching and quality leather, this wallet is designed to age beautifully over time, making it both a practical and stylish choice. Perfect as a personal purchase or as a thoughtful gift, this monogrammed leather wallet is a timeless addition to any wardrobe.
item.excerpt:encoded: Personalized Monogram Leather Wallet combines high-quality leather with a unique monogrammed design. Featuring embossed initials and multiple compartments, it offers style and practicality in a sleek bi-fold format. A perfect accessory for daily use, it’s compact, durable, and versatile.

item.title: Classic Leather Shoulder Bag
item.dc:creator: farazfrank777
item.content:encoded: The Classic Leather Shoulder Bag is the perfect blend of vintage charm and modern functionality, ideal for both work and casual outings. Handcrafted from premium full-grain leather, its rustic design and brass hardware provide a timeless aesthetic that complements any style. The bag features a spacious main compartment with multiple pockets, making it easy to carry a 13-inch laptop, notebooks, and other daily essentials. Its front buckle pockets add extra storage for smaller items, providing convenient access on the go. Designed with comfort in mind, the adjustable shoulder straps and padded handles make it versatile for long commutes or travel. Whether you wear it cross-body or over your shoulder, this bag ensures maximum comfort and style. The high-quality leather construction promises durability and longevity, making it a staple for anyone who values both fashion and practicality. Perfect for professionals, students, or travelers, this shoulder bag seamlessly blends style with utility.

item.title: Finest Quality Handbag
item.dc:creator: farazfrank777
item.content:encoded: The finest Quality Handbag is the perfect blend of elegance and functionality, designed for those who appreciate luxury and style. Crafted from premium materials, this handbag exudes sophistication with its sleek finish and attention to detail. Whether you’re heading to a business meeting or a casual outing, this versatile piece enhances any outfit, offering a statement of timeless fashion. The refined stitching and durable hardware ensure longevity, making it a valuable addition to your wardrobe. With spacious compartments and thoughtfully designed pockets, the handbag provides ample room to organize all your essentials—phone, wallet, makeup, and more—while maintaining a sleek profile. The comfortable straps make it easy to carry, and the bag’s lightweight design ensures you remain comfortable throughout the day. Ideal for fashion-forward individuals, this Finest Quality Handbag is not only a practical choice but also a symbol of elegance and refined taste.
